integer_validity_theorem: For an original integer vehicle route, at most one STAY site is connected at a slot (a vehicle in transit has none). The original connection rows force all other nonnegative Pch/Pdis to zero. If binary charge_mode=0, every Pch is zero; if charge_mode=1, the sole connected Pch is at most Pmax. Thus sum_site Pch <= Pmax*charge_mode. Interchanging charge and discharge proves sum_site Pdis <= Pmax*(1-charge_mode). All Original integer routes, travel/SOC states and P/Q operations are preserved.
